**The one rule: always start every job with Add a job, never in Mitti**
Don't create forms in Mitti yourself. Every job begins with **Add a job**. That creates the Mitti form for you with the customer's details already in it, and links everything together: the quote, the customer's emails and texts, the electrician, the rebate. A form started in Mitti isn't connected to any of that, so the quote can't be sent and the rebate can't be claimed.

**You don't need to keep checking anything**
Whenever something needs you, we text and email you with a link that takes you straight to it. Otherwise, you just do the Ready Check and the install.

**How it works from this weekend**

**1. Add the customer (30 seconds)**
Log in, tap **Add a job** in the menu at the bottom, and enter the customer's name, address, mobile and email, then tick to confirm the customer has agreed that Home Insulation Victoria can contact them. Please make sure the details are entered perfectly and in full: they automatically carry onto the quote and all the paperwork for the job from then on.

**2. The Mitti form is created for you**
Within about 15 minutes, the job's Ready Check form appears in Mitti with the customer's details already filled in. It's named with the customer's address and job number (for example HV-3117). You'll find it in Mitti under your inspections.

**3. Enter the visit day, and you'll get a reminder with the link**
Once you've arranged the Ready Check with your customer, enter the day and time, either in the optional box when you add the job, or later by opening the job. Every morning at 6:30am you then get a text listing that day's visits with a direct link to each Mitti form.

If you don't enter a day, that's fine, it's not a problem at all. You just won't get the morning text with the link, so you'd open Mitti and search for the form by the customer's address instead.

**4. Do the Ready Check**
Arrange the visit directly with your customer. At the home, fill out as much of the Ready Check form as you possibly can. All of it is needed to get the rebate. Anything not filled out transfers to install day, where it risks being forgotten and the rebate being rejected.

Press **Complete** only when the form is fully finished.

**5. Pressing Complete sends the quote**
The moment you press Complete, we automatically build the customer's quote: your price, plus our $349 Accredited Provider fee, plus the electrician's safety check, minus the VEU rebate. We never mark up your price. The quote is emailed and texted to the customer straight away. If anything is missing from your form, the quote waits until you've added it in Mitti.

**6. You're told when they accept**
The customer accepts online, signs everything we need and pays for the electrical safety check, all on their phone. You don't need to collect any consent or paperwork yourself. You get an email the moment they accept (or decline).

**7. Electrical safety check (PIESA)**
A licensed electrician does the official pre-installation electrical safety assessment. We arrange the electrician, unless you've added your own under **My business** (name, licence number, REC number and price). If anything needs fixing, the customer gets a separate quote, pays it, and the fixes are done and signed off first, with a Certificate of Electrical Safety. Install days can't be booked until that's done. We send you and the customer the PIESA at least 24 hours before the install. You can't start without it.

**8. Book the install**
Once the safety check is cleared, we text and email you to offer the customer three install days with arrival times. They tap one, or suggest other days, until you agree. The install must happen within 30 days of the safety check, and we remind you as the deadline gets closer.

**9. Install day**
Before the day, open the job in the portal and sign the safety plan (we write it for you from the job; your crew sign it with one tap). On the morning of the install, your 6:30am text includes the link to that job's install form in Mitti. It's short: the official safety checks, your declaration, then the after videos and depth photos the rebate needs. Everything is geotagged and timed, so photos must be taken at the property on the day.

**10. Getting paid**
The customer pays a 10% deposit when the install is booked and the balance on install day, by bank transfer. For your own customers, you're paid once that balance is paid. For jobs we send you, 7 days after we approve the job.

**Jobs we send you (our leads)**
These work the same way, with one difference at the start. We text and email you the job. Within 24 hours, you open it and offer the customer three days and times for the Ready Check (whenever suits you over the coming weeks). The customer taps the one that suits them, or suggests other days, and it's booked: you get a text with the day, time and address, and it's in your 6:30am reminder with the Mitti link. From there it's exactly the same as your own jobs, except the price is our price list, we arrange the electrician, and you're paid 7 days after we approve the job.
